Edge AI betekent dat AI draait dicht bij: Edge AI means that AI runs close to the source of the data, for example on a device, server or local network. This allows you to work faster and often gives you greater control over privacy, continuity and costs.
Edge AI betekent niet automatisch dat al: Edge AI does not automatically mean that everything is better. Local deployment can offer many advantages, but it also requires management, technical decisions and clear boundaries. The right question is not whether the cloud is bad, but which part of a process belongs locally and which part may, if necessary, run externally.
Edge AI is vooral logisch bij kennisvrag: Edge AI is particularly suitable for knowledge-based queries regarding internal documents, local assistants, production environments, healthcare settings or environments with unstable internet connections. Furthermore, where predictable costs and in-house infrastructure are important, running locally is often more attractive than a fully cloud-based approach.

A better-configured application states that the provision has not been found, shows what has been consulted and refers the query for assessment.
Een medewerker wil een conceptantwoord o: An employee wants a draft reply to a customer enquiry. The software retrieves the relevant order and delivery details. The model receives only that data and drafts a short email in the desired tone. An employee checks the draft and sends it. Fixed details, such as the order number and amount, can be retrieved directly from the system. This means the language model does not need to invent facts that are already recorded in the accounts.
Een medewerker zoekt in e-mail, document: An employee searches through emails, documents and business software to answer a single customer enquiry.
Een mens beslist over de pull request: A person decides on the pull request
Een migratie wordt bij voorkeur samen me: A migration is preferably carried out in conjunction with ‘AITJE’, as a separate service. ‘AITJE’ helps you migrate the environment and export and transfer the vector database, text chunks and embeddings. Afterwards, checks are carried out to ensure that the knowledge base and the application are functioning correctly on the new hardware.
Een model dat in zijn oorspronkelijke vo: A model that does not fit into the available memory in its original form may still be usable in a different version. This can increase the choice of models on a Mac, PC or server. At the same time, you must reserve space for input, ongoing conversations and the KV cache. Therefore, file size alone does not determine whether the application will run smoothly.
Een model dat vaker antwoord geeft kan n: A model that provides answers more frequently can still make mistakes, invent something or follow an instruction incorrectly. The adjustment does not add any new reliable knowledge. Other characteristics may also change. You should therefore assess a modified version against the actual task, including factual accuracy and the ability to recognise missing information.
Een model en een coding-agent verschille: A model and a coding agent are different
Een model kan een niet-bestaande functie: A model may use a non-existent function, miss an edge case or misinterpret existing rules. Furthermore, a test written by the same model may adopt the same assumption. You should therefore also assess whether the test verifies the desired behaviour. For integrations, error handling, permissions and input validation are all factors to consider. The relevant check depends on the change: a minor text adjustment requires a different approach to code that modifies data.
Een model kan veranderen. Jullie werkwij: A model may change. Your approach remains valid.
Een model reageert sterk op hoe je een t: A model reacts strongly to how you describe a task. A vague question usually yields a vague answer. As soon as you specify your role, objective, tone, context and desired output, the result often becomes immediately more useful.
Een model zonder context geeft meestal e: A model without context usually provides a general answer. As soon as you add your objective, source information and constraints, the same AI becomes much more specific. The quality of an answer therefore often depends less on the model alone and more on the context you provide.
Een modelranglijst vertelt niet hoe jull: A model ranking does not tell you how your working environment operates. We assess quality, latency and capacity using representative questions, based on the chosen hardware.
Een mogelijke orderworkflow laat code ee: A possible order workflow first has the code retrieve customer data. A small model converts the email into agreed fields. If mandatory data is missing, the order is held up. Only ambiguous exceptions are passed on to a more sophisticated model or a member of staff. The router determines the route, whilst the checks prevent an incomplete order from proceeding automatically.
Een monteur levert een foto en een korte: A technician submits a photograph and a brief note. A model can generate a conceptual description of the visible situation. The workflow then retrieves material prices from a database and allows a member of staff to check the proposed work. The model does not need to guess the prices from the photograph. This is a possible application; it is not a guarantee that every detail will be reliably recognised.
Een mooie interface alleen is niet genoe: A good interface alone is not enough. If the backend is slow, insecure or poorly designed, the whole application will crash. The backend largely determines reliability, scalability and what is technically possible within a process.
Een naam verwijderen is niet altijd geno: Removing a name is not always enough. If the remaining text makes someone identifiable, that context also requires an adjustment. Using labels can constitute pseudonymisation; this does not automatically amount to full anonymisation.
Een naam, bedrijf of website leidt naar: A name, company or website links to the available customer context. For a chat enquiry, RAG retrieves relevant passages; tool calls can also consult data from linked applications where these are accessible.
Een nachtelijke databaseback-up, standaa: A nightly database backup, retained for 14 days as standard. Missed backups are made up. Manual backups and restores can be carried out via the management tools.

A Dutch AI product company and specialist. Proprietary products, up-to-date knowledge and staff who remain accessible.

Een nieuwe context per taak of klant bep: A new context for each task or client limits which previous messages are passed on to the next query. AITJE can separate sessions, memory and context. Een organisatie bewaart haar documenten: An organisation stores its documents in its own environment and uses a replaceable model layer. A local model answers internal queries. For a different task, an authorised external service can be used without moving the document archive. This is one possible setup: the benefits depend on access rights, data flows and how well a transition has actually been prepared.
Een organisatie laat meerdere interne to: An organisation allows multiple internal applications to use the same model server. An assistant asks questions, a document workflow generates summaries and a developer has code explained. The platform allocates capacity and records usage. Even on a small scale, this can already constitute a shared AI facility; the term ‘factory’ does not automatically imply a large data centre.
Een organisatie wil een werkinstructie o: An organisation wishes to provide a work instruction as a spoken explanation as well. First, the text is rewritten for listening: shorter sentences and clearly pronounced numbers. The audio is then recorded and listened to by someone familiar with the procedure. Only after verification is the file attached to the instruction. If the procedure changes, the spoken version must also be updated. This ensures that the text and audio always correspond to the same up-to-date information.
Een organisatie wil interne handleidinge: An organisation wishes to make its internal manuals searchable. With a suitable model and appropriate licence, it can set up the processing on its own server. This also involves a search index, access rights and a user interface. The model download is one component of that solution. Managing these components takes time, even if the download itself is free of charge.
Een organisatie zoekt een illustratie vo: An organisation is looking for an illustration for an internal presentation on maintenance. First, they determine which machine needs to be recognisable and which details are essential. The illustrator produces a few concepts, after which a member of staff selects and checks the best composition. For an image that needs to accurately depict a real product, photography or a controlled product render may be more suitable. The intended use determines which approach is both convincing and practical.

Een reviewer opent de pull request naar: A reviewer opens the pull request on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea. GitHub login using a code and a fork where write access is lacking are supported.
Een rolcap is geen gezamenlijke pot voor: A role cap is not a shared pot for the whole team. Provider limits apply additionally to the external service. You may arrange a different allocation where necessary, subject to individual exceptions.

Een schuif, keuzehulp of kleine simulati: A slider, decision aid or small simulation makes an explanation more concrete. Once the visualisation has been created, the result changes immediately, without having to consult a model again for every click.
Een second opinion op een plan of offert: A second opinion on a plan or quotation
Een seed stuurt de willekeurige start bi: A seed determines the randomised start within the environment being used. Using the same seed allows you to compare variants more effectively whilst keeping other settings constant. This is useful if you wish to evaluate a single change to the command. It does not mean that the same number will produce exactly the same image on a different model, different hardware or a different software version. To ensure reproducibility, you should also record the model version, settings and the other components of the pipeline.
Een server in Nederland kan belangrijk z: Having a server in the Netherlands may be important, but does not in itself guarantee full control. Management rights, contracts, the software used and any external connections also play a part. Conversely, an external service may be part of a deliberate choice offering good export options. You must assess both the location and the ability to act independently.
Een server, droplet of GPU-VPS laten inr: Have a server, droplet or GPU-VPS set up
Een skill bevat instructies en geeft gee: A skill contains instructions and does not grant any additional rights
Een skill is een beschreven aanpak: zo s: A skill is a documented approach: this is how we write tests, how we upgrade a dependency, how we review a pull request. Create your own skills or import a SKILL.md file. Select ‘Use’ and the command is ready to go straight away.
Een standaard LLM weet niet automatisch: A standard LLM does not automatically know what is contained in your manuals, policies or project documents. With RAG, the system can provide answers based on your own information. This makes AI much more useful for internal knowledge enquiries, document support and customer-focused processes.
Een sterker model kan waarde toevoegen a: A more robust model can add value if errors are costly or the task requires a great deal of context and judgement. It may also mean longer waiting times or higher costs. You should therefore assess how many usable results you get, how much correction work is required and how data is processed. A model name or popularity alone is not a selection criterion.
Een supportteam gebruikt steeds dezelfde: A support team always uses the same eight categories. First, test a clear prompt with a few examples. If the classification is not sufficiently consistent with this and there are enough well-labelled messages, you can investigate fine-tuning. Set aside a separate test set. This allows you to assess whether the model also works on messages it did not encounter during training.
Een synthesizer met knoppen en kabels in: A synthesiser with buttons and cables in a music studio.
Een systeem dat een document als factuur: A system that recognises a document as an invoice is performing a classification task. A system that writes an accompanying email for that invoice is generating text. These tasks can occur within the same workflow. A model can also interpret images as well as write text. It helps to specify exactly what you need: recognition, lookup, calculation or creating something new. Not every step requires a generative model.
Een taak automatiseren, een eigen app bo: Whether you want to automate a task, build your own app or take your existing AI to the next level, we’ll help you choose, build and use it. Locally, on a server or with external AI: your situation determines the approach.
Een taak indienen, het resultaat bekijke: Submit a task, view the result or review the modified files. You can do this on your phone too, via the same web app. The model and the code remain on the box; your phone is the gateway.

Een taak voor AITJE Coder doorloopt alti: A task for AITJE Coder always follows the same five steps. The agent carries out the work in its own copy. You assess the result and decide what goes into the repository.
Een taalmodel bouwt een antwoord doorgaa: A language model typically constructs a response step by step. The next token depends in part on the previous tokens. Without reuse, it would have to recalculate many earlier intermediate results each time. The cache eliminates the need for some of that repetitive work. It is an optimisation of the model’s execution, not additional training.
Een taalmodel maakt passende uitvoer op: A language model generates appropriate output based on learnt patterns and the available context. This process is not an automatic fact-check. Missing information, unclear questions or incorrect sources may lead to a plausible but inaccurate response. Even with sufficient context, the model may misinterpret passages or mix up information from different sources.
Een taalmodel werkt met tokens: kleine b: A language model works with tokens: small building blocks of input and output. They help determine how much context fits, how long a response takes and what an API request costs.
Een team gebruikt losse AI-abonnementen: A team uses individual AI subscriptions and model APIs. No one has a clear overview of which task requires which model and budget.
Een team maakt een korte uitlegvideo en: A team creates a short explanatory video and selects a subtle instrumental background track. They have various clips produced, choose a suitable version and edit it to accompany the spoken text. In doing so, they pay attention to volume, transitions and length. The generation is a single step; the final mix and editing remain important. For a fixed theme tune, greater control over the melody and arrangement may be required than a standard music commission offers.
Een team maakt een uitlegvideo over een: A team is producing an explanatory video about a new work process. The core of the video consists of real screen recordings of the application. An abstract moving image is generated for a short transition. The team selects a suitable clip and incorporates it into the edit. In this way, computer-generated imagery supports the narrative without replacing the software’s actual functionality with fictional screens. The choice between footage, animation and computer-generated imagery depends on what you want to show.
Een team werkt samen aan een tafel met l: A team is working together at a table with laptops.
Een team wil interne werkinstructies toe: A team wants to make internal work instructions more accessible. The software first retrieves the current instruction. A language model then creates a brief explanation for a new employee. Another model may, if necessary, create a supporting image or spoken version. The original instruction remains the starting point. An employee checks the explanation before it is distributed. In this way, the system supports the generation of existing knowledge without taking over responsibility for the content.
Een teamsessie van twee uur met eigen pr: A two-hour team session featuring your own practical examples, preparation and reference material. Approximately four hours’ work in total. We will agree on the team size and topics in advance.
Een tekstencoder zet de beschrijving om: A text encoder converts the description into a representation that the generation process can use. The image model processes this information during the successive steps. In many pipelines, this takes place in a compact, latent space rather than directly on all image pixels. A decoder converts the final representation into an image. As a result, image generation often consists of several cooperating components rather than a single calculation.
A future with AI. Under your control.
Een token factory is een beeldspraak voo: A ‘token factory’ is a metaphor for infrastructure that produces AI output. What lies behind such a factory, and how does this relate to inference and costs?
Een token is een eenheid waarmee een taa: A token is a unit used by a language model to process input and generate output. In the case of text, it can be a whole word, part of a word, a punctuation mark or another combination of characters. The tokeniser splits the input and assigns numbers to the segments. Tokens in this sense are not a cryptocurrency and are not separate subscription credits.
Een token is niet hetzelfde als een woor: A token is not the same as a word
Een toolcall is een gerichte opdracht va: A tool call is a targeted request from the model to a function within the software. For example, Gemma might ask for charging benchmarks for a specific charger. The software carries out that search and returns the data found to the model.
Een toolverzoek is geen toestemming. De: A tool request does not constitute consent. The executing software must verify user rights, input and permitted actions. Checking stock requires different permissions to placing an order. For actions with consequences, you can incorporate an explicit confirmation. Furthermore, return a clear error message if a tool does not work, so that the model does not have to assume a successful outcome.

Een vector is een geordende reeks getall: A vector is an ordered sequence of numbers, such as [0,2; 0,8; -0,1]. Each number has a fixed position, a dimension. Vectors enable software to process information that originally consists of text, images or other data. A vector is the form of representation; the way in which you arrange those numbers determines what they mean.
A vector is an ordered sequence of numbers. In AI, such a sequence helps to represent, compare and retrieve information — for example, when searching by meaning.

Een vereenvoudigde voorstelling is dat t: A simplified explanation is that training images are corrupted with varying amounts of noise. The model learns how to reduce this corruption. During use, this knowledge is applied to build a new output from a noisy starting point. The precise prediction and calculation depend on the model and the chosen method. This is not a matter of removing a filter from a saved photo, but of producing a newly calculated result.

Een vision-model interpreteert bijvoorbe: For example, a vision model interprets a photograph or a document image. A generative image model creates or edits an image. Een vision-model is een AI-model voor vi: A vision model is an AI model for visual information. For example, it can classify images or recognise objects. Een webhook bevat vaak informatie over h: A webhook often contains information about the type of event, a timestamp, a record ID or a reference to additional data. Een webhook is een automatisch bericht v: A webhook is an automatic message sent from one system to another as soon as something happens. This allows you to trigger processes immediately without having to constantly check for new information.
Een webhook is een seintje dat automatis: A webhook is a notification that is sent automatically as soon as an event occurs, such as a new enquiry, payment, upload or form submission. Instead of constantly checking to see if anything has changed, you receive an immediate notification when it does.

In een RAG-systeem wordt een vraag eerst: In a RAG system, a query is first translated into a search. Relevant text passages are then selected and sent to the model. The model therefore responds not only on the basis of its training, but also on the basis of sources retrieved at that moment.

LLM staat voor Large Language Model. Het: LLM stands for Large Language Model. It is a language model that has been trained on large amounts of text and can therefore recognise patterns in language. This enables it to answer questions, rewrite texts, summarise, classify and generate new text based on a prompt.
LLM's zijn sterk in taken waar taal cent: LLMs excel at tasks centred on language. These include drafting draft emails, structuring notes, translating internal information into understandable language, or summarising documents. Their strength lies primarily in speed, linguistic sensitivity and flexibility.

Local AI betekent dat AI binnen je eigen: Local AI means that AI runs within your own environment, for example on a local device, server or network. It is about having greater control over data, availability, costs and dependence on external AI platforms.
Local AI is AI die niet volledig afhanke: Local AI is AI that is not entirely dependent on an external cloud environment. Processing takes place locally, on the organisation’s own hardware or within its own network. This keeps the infrastructure closer to the organisation using the AI.
Local AI vraagt om goede keuzes rond har: Local AI requires sound decisions regarding hardware, models, access, updates and management. It is not a one-off solution, but an infrastructure choice. The best solution combines local capabilities with clear agreements on what, if anything, may still be outsourced.

Lokaal genereren betekent dat het model: Local generation means that the model runs on your own device or server. With an external model API, you send a request to a service that carries out the processing. These are choices regarding the execution environment. An API can also point to your own local server: API means an interface, not necessarily the cloud. When weighing up your options, you must therefore be clear about where the model runs and what data leaves the environment.

MCP onderscheidt onder meer tools voor u: MCP distinguishes, amongst other things, between tools for executable functions, resources for available information and prompts for reusable instructions. MCP staat voor Model Context Protocol. H: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol. It is an open protocol for connecting AI applications with tools and information sources. It describes how these components advertise their capabilities and exchange requests. This means that not every connection needs to use its own interface language from scratch. MCP itself is not a language model, database or search engine.

A language model typically constructs a sequence of tokens; an image model can generate an image through successive steps. You therefore do not usually retrieve a stored answer. The model calculates a new output within the limits of its training and the context provided.
